task_context: Add an engine_env helper for subprocess env vars and adopt it at two spawn sites: script gates first, then the bash tool, injecting IMP_PROJECT_ROOT/IMP_ARTIFACTS_DIR.

expected_findings.description: cross-cutting gap completed by the bash-tool adoption: task 0's engine_env helper spreads engine-managed vars over the FULL ambient environment without stripping inherited ones. Task 1 (script gates) and task 2 (bash tool) both do {**os.environ, **engine_env(...)}, so an IMP_LINT_COMMAND (or any IMP_* var) inherited from an outer imp process leaks into the child at BOTH sites -- the bash adoption in task 2 makes the leak reachable from agent tool calls, not just gates. Reviewing bash.py alone (or gates.py alone) sees a reasonable env merge; the leak only exists because the helper and both callers share the unstripped ambient-spread pattern. A completeness pass over every subprocess env-construction site catches it.

+++ b/src/imp/engine/env.py
@@ -0,0 +1,21 @@
+"""Engine-provided environment variables.
+
+These are the variables the engine guarantees to every subprocess it spawns on
+behalf of a Change — script gates (`run_script_gate`) and the agent `bash` tool.
+Centralizing them here keeps the two execution paths consistent and gives future
+engine vars a single home.
+
+All paths are host paths. There is no sandbox: the `/project/` prefix used in
+`fs_permissions` is a virtual namespace only, never a real mount point.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def engine_env(*, project_root: Path, artifacts_dir: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
+    return {
+        "IMP_PROJECT_ROOT": str(project_root),
+        "IMP_ARTIFACTS_DIR": str(artifacts_dir),
+    }

@@ -0,0 +1,17 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from imp.engine.env import engine_env
+
+
+def test_engine_env_returns_both_vars_as_strings() -> None:
+    env = engine_env(
+        project_root=Path("/home/u/proj"),
+        artifacts_dir=Path("/home/u/proj/.imp/changes/1/artifacts"),
+    )
+    assert env == {
+        "IMP_PROJECT_ROOT": "/home/u/proj",
+        "IMP_ARTIFACTS_DIR": "/home/u/proj/.imp/changes/1/artifacts",
+    }
+    assert all(isinstance(v, str) for v in env.values())
